messages:
ana-docs: ran the Quickstart today and noticed a few inconsistent snippets across SDKs and the top README. The curl snippet uses REDWOOD_KEY but SDKs (python/go/js) read REDWOOD_API_KEY. Folks are pasting and getting 401s.

lee-sdks: thanks, that's been a thorn. also the Go sample in the README is using the old client constructor signature (NewClientWithOpts) — that was changed in v1.3.0. New users grab the README and hit compile errors.

omar-eng: any chance the curl example also confuses Windows users? we had a support ticket where PowerShell swallowed the header because double quotes were used.

ana-docs: yup. I'm planning three edits: 1) change env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere; 2) add a small PowerShell variant that uses $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY; 3) replace the Go constructor with the v1.3-compatible snippet and add a one-line note about SDK retry behavior (SDKs retry with exponential backoff; curl is single shot).

julia-devex: can you paste the proposed Go snippet here so I can sanity-check for onboarding docs? SEs will reference it in their checklist.

ana-docs: sure:

```go
// Go (module-aware) example - works with github.com/redwood-inference/sdk v1.3.0+
package main

import (
  "context"
  "fmt"
  "os"
  ri "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk"
)

func main() {
  apiKey := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
  client := ri.NewClient(ri.WithAPIKey(apiKey)) // v1.3 API
  resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), ri.GenerateRequest{Prompt: "Hello"})
  if err != nil {
    fmt.Println("request failed:", err)
    return
  }
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```

julia-devex: looks good. tiny nit: call out module import path and go mod init example in the quickstart for absolute newbies.

lee-sdks: I'll bump the Go example in the upstream repo. Also will add a compatibility table in the SDK docs that maps quickstart snippets to SDK versions.

ana-docs: opened PR with edits and migration notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/623. Also filed a docs UI follow-up to add copy buttons and a small runtime selector on the quickstart page (desktop: #412 docs-ui).

site-bot: docs site rebuild scheduled (job 9120), estimated 6m.

omar-eng: once live, I'll update the internal onboarding checklist and the runbook snippet. Thanks — this should cut down the support noise.

julia-devex: can we add a one-liner in the README: "If you paste into PowerShell, use $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY or single quotes to avoid header interpolation"? saves an extra support step.

ana-docs: good call. I'll add that and close the loop after the PR merges.
